About.title: About
About.metaDescription: Islamic School Finder helps families search, compare and match Islamic schools in English, Arabic and Malay.
About.intro: Choosing a school is one of the biggest decisions a family makes. We bring information about Islamic schools together so it is easier to understand.
About.levelsTitle: How we show how reliable the information is

sections.title: Why this exists
sections.text: Information about Islamic schools is scattered across websites, social media and word of mouth, and it is often only in one language. Islamic School Finder collects it in one place, in English, Arabic and Malay.

sections.title: What you can do
sections.text: Search by place, curriculum, grade, fees, Quran and Arabic teaching and more. Add up to four schools to a side-by-side comparison. Save the ones you like and message a school directly once you have a free account.

sections.title: How “Find My School” works
sections.text: It counts only the preferences you set. For every school each preference is shown as matched, not matched, or not provided by the school, for example “Matches 8 of your 10 preferences”. There is no hidden score, and a school’s verification level does not change the order.

sections.title: Corrections and schools
sections.text: If something is wrong, tell us through the contact page. School staff can claim their profile, and our team reviews every claim before giving access.

ContactPage.title: Contact us
ContactPage.intro: Questions, corrections or ideas are welcome.
ContactPage.emailMissing: Our contact email has not been set up yet.

sections.title: What to write to us about
sections.text: Corrections to a school’s details, a school that is missing, problems with your account, or feedback on the site. For questions about a particular school, such as places or fees, use the “Message this school” box on its page.

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.intro: What we keep, who can see it, and the choices you have.

sections.title: What we keep
sections.text: If you create an account: your name, email address and password (the password is stored in a protected form, never as plain text). We also keep the schools you save, the messages you send to schools, and any school claims you submit.

sections.title: Who can see it
sections.text: When you message a school, we share your name, email, phone number (if you gave one) and message with that school so it can reply. If you claim a school, our review team sees your claim details. We do not show your account details to other visitors.

sections.title: Cookies and browser storage
sections.text: We use a cookie to keep you signed in, and your browser’s storage to remember the schools you add to a comparison. This site does not currently use advertising or analytics cookies.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.text: You can log out at any time. To see, correct or delete your information, or to close your account, contact us through the contact page.
